title: Brothers and sisters
summary: She had many brothers and sisters, including twins born on her own birthday in a different year.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: We'll get to that as we get along. But getting back to Atlanta, did you have any brothers or sisters then?
Oh, many, maybe nine or eleven. Twins - I have two twins that were born on the same day I was born but a different year, the 8th of May.
